long_biography.plain_text:
By the time Rock-Tenn agreed to acquire Southern Container, the business combined a recycled-paperboard mill with eight box plants, two sheet plants and four graphics facilities. Its former owners included Bob Grossman and his brother Steven, members of the family behind the packaging company. The 2008 transaction exchanged the privately held manufacturer for cash and shifted their economic base away from operating assets.

Grossman and his wife Lynne later became managers of a private Florida limited-liability company. The couple also pursued real-estate investment and development after the packaging sale, although the composition and scale of that portfolio remain private. Their continuing joint management of a Florida entity reflects a later investment phase, but does not establish Grossman's present day-to-day mandate or dominant industry.
